name: node-engine-guard
description: Codex SessionStart hook that fails when non-interactive node does not satisfy package.json engines.node.

interface.shortDescription: Fail fast when Codex sees a node version that does not satisfy package.json engines.node.
interface.longDescription: Adds a Codex SessionStart hook that verifies the actual non-interactive node on PATH against the current project's package.json engines.node range and fails on mismatch. Useful when interactive shells use nvm or aliases but agent subprocesses resolve a different node.
